exit 0
--- stdout
Resume the Liza system from a resumable mode or sprint state, or acknowledge an active HALT response.
This command can be used when:
- System is in PAUSED mode (sets mode to RUNNING)
- Sprint is at CHECKPOINT status (sets status to IN_PROGRESS)
- Both (resumes from both states)
- System is STOPPED with an unresolved HALT (acknowledges it and remains STOPPED)
For transitions to RUNNING or IN_PROGRESS, agents resume normal operation at
their next check.
liza resume cannot restart stopped agents. After it acknowledges a HALT while
STOPPED, run liza start and restart agents manually. STOPPED without an active
HALT remains invalid for resume.
Usage:
liza resume [flags]
Flags:
--changed-by string identifier for audit trail (overrides LIZA_AGENT_ID env var, defaults to 'human')
-h, --help help for resume
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
